score_rationale: Agentic AI is Deva's strongest lane (3 autonomous-agent projects + grounded-AI guardrail current role directly hit 'systems that do', agent eval, tool-use reliability, safety guardrails, reduce manual toil). Docked from higher only because the specific named orchestration frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen) and the DataRobot platform itself are gaps; LlamaIndex is the one truthfully-held framework.
